title: Mark Villar joined Senate majority to help ensure stability, says Gatchalian
summary: MANILA – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said Sen. Mark Villar joined the chamber’s majority bloc to help maintain stability and ensure the Senate’s legislative work continues smoothly.
